simple.summary: אִבְצָן (ʼIbtsân) means Ibtsan , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Judg 12 8.

definitions.full: H78. Ibtsan אִבְצָן proper name, masculine judge of Isr . Judg 12:8 , 10 (Lag GN 1891, 19 ᵐ5 צָן, (אֲ)בֶן Ἀβεσσαν , ᵑ6 ). אבק (Arabic run away (compare Lag BN 51 )).
